map.叶天士创立的温热病辨证体系，反映温病由表入里、由轻到重的传变层次（卫→气→营→血: Ye Tianshi's differentiation system for warm-heat disease, reflecting the layers of transmission from exterior to interior and from mild to severe (wei → qi → ying → xue)
map.卫气营血按传变层次辨证：卫分（发热微恶寒、头痛、脉浮数）为表证初起；气分（壮热、: Wei, qi, ying and xue differentiate by transmission layer: the wei level (fever with slight aversion to cold, headache, floating rapid pulse) is the onset of an exterior syndrome; the qi level (high fever, no aversion to cold, sweating, flooding rapid pulse) is flourishing internal heat; the ying level (fever worse at night, restlessness and insomnia, crimson tongue) is heat scorching ying yin; the xue level (maculae and rash, bleeding, deep crimson tongue) is heat blazing and stirring blood. Judge the layer in the order wei, qi, ying, xue, with treatments of acrid-cool exterior release, clearing heat and draining fire, clearing ying and driving heat out, and cooling blood and dispersing stasis respectively.

map.💡 传变规律：卫→气→营→血为顺传（由浅入深）；卫→营/血为逆传（心包），病情凶: 💡 Transmission rule: wei → qi → ying → xue is sequential transmission (shallow to deep); wei → ying or xue is reverse transmission (into the pericardium) and is critical. Ye Tianshi said: "In the wei level, sweating suffices; at qi level only then may qi be cleared; entering ying one may still drive heat out of ying; entering xue one fears consuming and stirring blood, so cool the blood and disperse stasis at once."

map.四层含义？: What do the four layers mean?
map.卫（表热）、气（里热盛）、营（热入营分扰神）、血（动血耗血），由浅入深。: Wei (exterior heat), qi (flourishing internal heat), ying (heat entering the ying level and disturbing the mind) and xue (stirring and consuming blood), from shallow to deep.
map.和三焦区别？: How does it differ from the three jiao?
map.叶天士卫气营血偏温热病深浅，吴鞠通三焦偏部位，常互参。: Ye Tianshi's wei-qi-ying-xue focuses on the depth of warm disease while Wu Jutong's three jiao focuses on location; the two are often read together.
